boundary_note: Restriction to these four relations is a declared boundary of this demo, not a claim about language coverage. A reading outside the set is reported as NO_CANDIDATE (miss), never silently mapped to the nearest relation.

candidate_generation.rule: For each frame slot propose ALL declared relations minus provable type/arity incompatibility. No semantic form->value filters: a construction does not determine the value, and pre-filtering would hint the answer to the selector. In particular 'u + GEN' admits a spatial reading; LOCATIVE is never excluded by form alone.
